rationale: AREA 3 is best (7.55-8.39 ns) vs DELAY 3/4 (8.9-9.4) and AREA 2 (12.4). AREA 3 runs ended with 2-4 ns positive slack, so T_eff reflects netlist/placement, not repair; loose-target runs were worse, consistent with IO delays scaling with period. The best two share timing-driven placement, no routability mode, cap213 RC and post-GRT timing repair; constraints have ample headroom. Both proposals keep these and use the tightest target (8.59 ns) with high setup margins, shrinking the IO term and letting repair act if estimates exceed 8.2 ns. A: best run (ocs_blitter) tightened, slightly denser. B: denser placement (util 48, density 65), ABC buffering+sizing, post-GRT design repair.
